name: barrier_m1_L06_green
trained_on: MolmoAct2-LIBERO (allenai/MolmoAct2-LIBERO-LeRobot), LIBERO sim, two cameras (agentview + wrist), two cubes (red/green); on-policy velocity matching to the same frozen policy prompted "pick up the green cube"; students "pick up the cube" and "pick up the red cube" (the mirror of barrier_r3_L06; one refresh round). Not fitted on MolmoAct2-SO100_101 and may not transfer.
alpha_unit: module scale: median L2 norm of text-token activations at this layer (fit set)

bank.how: mean block-6 output of the task-span tokens ' pick up the green cube' under the green teacher prompt over the mirror round-0 observations (steervla runs/steering_dial/data/mirror_r0_0/bank.npy); frozen

results: steervla runs/steering_dial/results.md section 9 (LIBERO val, 104 hard layouts): hard green 78% barrier vs 77% fixed -L6 vector and 74% trained constant; it failed the pre-registered gate (needs +3 over the fixed vector), so it has no LIBERO test. Offline on held-out SO-101 real frames (steervla runs/steering_so101 section 8, zero-shot): green-teacher loss 0.00509 vs 0.0111 no edit.
k_note: k scales the edit (ControlLLM form): u = k * ReLU(tau - <a,h>) a; k=0 no edit, k=1 trained.
